basis: Source: Pape-Dawson model drawing '261111 - Overall Grading & Utilities-Model.dwg' and sheet C2.00 Mass Grading Plan (issue for construction 11-27-2024, interim review 11/11/2026), Texas South Central state plane, 3 ft grid.

Limits = the coloured area of the engineer's cut/fill heat map (85.9 AC in all). Phase I (northwest) is complete under a separate permit and is outside it. This job is Phase 3 (Buildings 4-7) only: 35.2 AC. Each cell goes with the nearer group of buildings, so the phase line runs midway between Building 3 and Building 4.

Existing ground from the existing 1 ft contours. Finish grade from the proposed 1 ft contours, the 376 cut/fill depth labels on the heat map, the seven finished floors, and ties to existing ground along the limits where no proposed contour runs.

Check of the whole sheet against the engineer's Volume Summary (surface to surface, no strip, no sections): cut 293,439 CY vs 302,022 (-2.8%), fill 375,791 CY vs 377,238 (-0.4%); 99% of cells fall inside the heat map's colour band.

Geotech (user, 2026-11-13): ECS Southwest report 20:1780 for San Antonio Supplier Park Building 01 (Nov 30 2023) and letter 20:1780-A (Apr 22 2024), used until this job's own report arrives. It was written for Building 01, not these buildings.

Building pads (ECS 4.1 and 5.3): undercut 2 ft and fill to finished floor with select fill (PI 5 to 20), carried 5 ft beyond the walls. Where the pad is in fill the undercut is below the stripped ground; where it is in cut it is 2 ft below the floor. Select fill 93,441 CY over 48,332 SY of pad; the undercut is inside the excavation total and the pads carry no general fill. Slab thickness is not deducted. The ECS letter says the on-site soils are similar to the select fill criteria and can build the pad. This replaces the 8 ft hold-down (4 ft moisture conditioned + 4 ft select) assumed on 11/12.

Paving from the architect's site base (curbs, buildings, stall striping): everything inside the curbs is pavement; the striped stalls are light duty, the rest heavy duty. ECS 4.6 rigid sections: light duty 5.0 in PCC (20,000 ESAL); heavy duty 7.0 in PCC (Heavy-Duty-3, 400,000 ESAL). ECS lists five heavy duty options from 6.0 to 8.5 in; the paving plan was not supplied, so the middle one is carried. No base course in the rigid options.

Subgrade prep (ECS 5.1): after stripping and cuts, scarify, moisture condition and recompact 8 in. Stripping runs 10 ft beyond buildings and 5 ft beyond paving; here the whole coloured area is stripped. Strip 4 in assumed (no topsoil depth in the report); no shrink or swell.

Utilities: lengths from the proposed-utility xref. Pipe labels are broken references in the drawing, so every pipe size is a placeholder (water 8 in, wastewater 8 in, storm 24 in) and all depths are assumed. Electric conduit, gas and telecom are not taken off.
